details: Coinbase Clearing LLC has been registered by the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) as a derivatives clearing organization. This approval, effective September 28, 2026, allows Coinbase to clear fully collateralized futures, options on futures, and swaps, completing its regulated US derivatives business infrastructure. The clearinghouse is designed for USDC collateral and 24/7 settlement.
title: Coinbase Secures CFTC Approval for Derivatives Clearinghouse

details: Crypto exchange Bitget experienced a $357 million hack on Thursday, with analytics firm Elliptic Enterprises Ltd. indicating a likely connection to North Korea-linked hackers. This incident reportedly pushes North Korea's total digital-asset theft haul past $1 billion this year. Bitget's CEO confirmed the loss is covered by a user protection fund, and withdrawals are being gradually restored.
title: Bitget Hacked for $357M, Linked to North Korea

details: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade is scheduled for activation on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026. This significant scaling update introduces enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) via EIP-7732 and block-level access lists, aiming to boost Layer-1 throughput. While a crucial testing milestone for client teams, mainnet activation dates are yet to be announced.
title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade to Testnet Oct 6

details: At the Sibos 2026 conference, Swift CEO Javier Perez-Tasso stated that the discussion has shifted from "TradFi vs. DeFi" to how Swift's platform can facilitate the global movement of any regulated value, whether fiat or tokenized. He highlighted the ongoing success with 17 pioneering banks utilizing Swift's blockchain-based ledger for 24/7 real-time payments across six continents.
title: Swift CEO: No Longer TradFi vs. DeFi, Focus on Regulated Tokenized Value

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced that its Ethereum holdings have surpassed 6 million ETH, valued at approximately $16 billion. This substantial accumulation represents about 4.9% of the total ETH supply, making Bitmine the largest corporate holder of Ether. The company also reported that over 85% of its ETH is staked on its proprietary MAVAN platform, generating significant annualized revenue.
title: Bitmine's ETH Treasury Exceeds 6 Million Tokens ($16 Billion)
